item.title: Despite Cease-Fire, Iran’s Hackers Haven’t Logged Off
item.summary: Tehran’s digital warriors have continued to seek ways to gain an advantage in the conflict in a new phase of cyberspace operations.

item.title: Bahrain Charges Intelligence Officer in the Death of a Detainee
item.summary: The officer was charged with assault leading to death, in the case of a man who was accused by Bahraini authorities of espionage during a domestic crackdown tied to the war in Iran.

item.title: How Trump’s Blockade of the Strait of Hormuz Works
item.summary: Our business reporter Peter Eavis breaks down how American military ships have blocked Iranian-linked vessels from using the Strait of Hormuz as the U.S. encourages other vessels to make the passage.

item.title: Hegseth Again Threatens Attacks on Iran’s Civilian Infrastructure
item.summary: The U.S. blockade of shipments through the Strait of Hormuz would last “for as long as it takes,” the defense secretary said.

item.title: White House Declines to Offer Congress an Estimate of Iran War Cost
item.summary: Russell T. Vought, the White House budget director, said the fluctuating nature of the U.S.-Israeli war made it difficult to pinpoint expenses.

item.title: A Timeline of the Lebanon-Israel Relationship
item.summary: Israeli and Lebanese officials this week met in Washington for direct talks between two nations, which have technically been at war since 1948.

item.title: House Again Thwarts Challenge to Trump’s Authority to Continue Iran War
item.summary: The G.O.P. narrowly blocked a Democratic war powers resolution, but a senior Republican suggested that backing for the conflict is not open-ended and could wane as a statutory deadline approaches in weeks.

item.title: White House Shrugs Off Shaky Economy as War Exceeds Trump’s Timeline
item.summary: Stocks may be soaring again, but the war in Iran has started to pinch the finances of many Americans.

item.title: Senate Blocks Bid to Cancel Arms Sales to Israel as Iran War Deepens Democratic Divide
item.summary: Concerns over the Iran war led several Democratic senators who had rejected past bids to curb weapons transfers to Israel to vote to block the sale of bulldozers and bombs.

item.title: Trump’s Portrayal of the War in Iran Collides With Reality
item.summary: President Trump is confronting a crisis that is not bending to his narrative of a “pretty reasonable” new regime in Iran and all-but-assured victory for the United States.
